name: claude-scientific-writer
description: K-Dense's scientific writing toolkit: 23 skills (papers, grants, posters, clinical reports, paper-2-web) plus a /scientific-writer-init command. NOTE: 22 of these 23 skills also appear in sci-* plugins; only paper-2-web is unique to the writer. To avoid duplicate skills, install EITHER claude-scientific-writer OR the relevant sci-* plugins, not both.
